title: Queue
body:
CUSTOMER: Hi, please stay within the queue!
<<cut_queue>>
HANA: I HAVE NO TIME FOR THIS!

title: ManReply
body: CUSTOMER: Oh she must have really been in a hurry, it's alright.

title: Counter
body:
HANA: Hi, I'd like a coffee.
CLERK: Hello! What can I get you?
HANA: A mocha latte, please.
<<show_coffee>>
CLERK: Here you go, it's $5.
HANA: Hmmm... I don't think I want to pay for it...
<<take_coffee>>
CLERK: That's on us then! Have a lovely day ahead!
